expectations.text: The guide names the receiving location and enters 6000 grams and $0.012 per gram, with cost per stock unit distinguished from total sack cost.
expectations.evidence: Names Items > select item > Receive existing stock and explains cost of one stock unit; Flour entries are Quantity 6000 and Cost $0.012 for a 6 kg, $72 sack.

expectations.text: The check has observable fields and expected values, with correction before Post and a warning that blank cost becomes zero.
expectations.evidence: Step 2 gives exact expected values; step 3 checks both fields before Post, warns blank cost is zero, and permits direct correction.

expectations.text: After posting, it uses the History receipt ID and inventory lead for audited correction; it invents neither an undo nor a cost-unit selector.
expectations.evidence: Names History location and receipt ID, prohibits posted edit/undo, routes errors to inventory lead for audited correction, and states there is no cost-unit selector.
